name: HTTP Host Header Bypass

decision_points.if: HTTP response indicates "blocked" without Host header, but shows content with "pi.hole" Host header
decision_points.then: Use "pi.hole" as a valid hostname for the target

success_indicators: Successfully receive HTTP response other than 403 Forbidden or blocked page

decision_points.then: Zone transfer is not enabled or configured for these zones

name: Default Raspberry Pi Credentials Login

decision_points.if: SSH login prompt or successful login with username 'pi'
decision_points.then: Attempt default Raspberry Pi credentials (username: pi, password: raspberry)

success_indicators: Successful SSH login prompt or shell access

name: Sudo All Commands Privilege Escalation

indicators: User has passwordless sudo access to all commands

decision_points.if: User can run 'sudo -l' and sees 'ALL' commands allowed without a password
decision_points.then: Execute 'sudo su -' to gain root privileges

follow_up: Examine mounted file systems for sensitive data

name: Examine Block Device for Deleted Files (grep)

decision_points.if: A block device like /dev/sdb is suspected to contain deleted sensitive files
decision_points.then: Use grep with a pattern matching potential flag formats on the block device

success_indicators: Extracted text resembling a flag or sensitive data

name: Remote Disk Image Compression and Transfer
execution: ssh pi@$TARGET "sudo dcfldd if=/dev/sdb bs=4M | gzip -1" | dd of=pi.dd.gz

decision_points.if: Need to exfiltrate data from a block device on a remote system
decision_points.then: Use SSH to execute dcfldd on the block device, pipe output to gzip for compression, and save locally

success_indicators: Compressed disk image file created locally

name: Forensic Disk Image Analysis (TestDisk)

decision_points.if: A disk image file is available and contains a detected partition
decision_points.then: Use TestDisk to analyze the partition structure and attempt file recovery

success_indicators: Deleted files listed or recovered by TestDisk
follow_up: Analyze recovered files or hex dump if recovery fails

name: Examine Deleted File Contents in Hex Editor

indicators: Deleted file identified but content not fully recovered
Disk image or block device available

decision_points.if: Forensic tools fail to fully recover deleted file content
decision_points.then: Open the block device or disk image in a hex editor and search for known patterns

success_indicators: Relevant data extracted from hex dump
